m3d.res: Grid of the 3D viewer; {nrt} = cells along RT, {nmz} = cells along m/z.
m3d.read.nom: 3D cursor readout; {n} = nominal mass of the cell (integer).
m3d.xic: Title of the small XIC plot of the 3D viewer; {mz} = m/z value under the cursor.
m3d.spc: Title of the small spectrum of the 3D viewer; {rt} = retention time in minutes.
m3d.xic.uv: Title of the small plot of the 3D view of a DAD map: absorbance against time at the wavelength under the cursor; {mz} = nm.
m3d.spc.uv: Title of the small plot of the 3D view of a DAD map; {rt} = time in min.
